summary: Standalone card for a session, with time, content, speakers, and an action slot.
whenToUse: Showing a session independently of a schedule grid.
whenNotToUse: Linear schedules: use Agenda and AgendaItem. For speakers use ProfileCard.

props.name: speakers
props.description: Slot for speaker names or links.

inherits: HTML attributes of the <article> except title.

keyboard.action: Reaches the title link, if present, and the controls provided in the action.

accessibility: Uses an article labelled by the title; the title can be a link without extending the link to the actions.
responsive: Metadata and slots adapt to the available width.
customization: Uses --dc-* tokens and className on the container.
commonMistakes: Don’t duplicate the speaker profile presentation: reuse ProfileCard when you need a real speaker card.
limits: Does not handle booking or calendar sync.
